state.description: Toggle with the key gesture on the internal keyboard, or with this switch

devices.title: Devices
devices.empty: No managed keyboards. Check the devices list in /etc/kbdguard/config.toml

protect.label: Never disable the last keyboard
protect.description: Disabling is refused when no enabled keyboard would remain

gesture.label: Gesture: {gesture}
gesture.hint: Hold Ctrl and press Alt on the internal keyboard. A third key cancels the gesture. For niri you can also bind: Mod+Shift+K -> kbdguard toggle

daemon.hint: Install the backend (backend/install.sh) and start it: sudo systemctl start kbdguard

poll.label: Poll interval
poll.description: How often the widget asks the daemon for its state

hide.label: Hide without daemon
hide.description: Do not show the icon when the daemon is not running

backend.hint: The daemon and its configuration live in backend/ of the plugin repository. Gesture and device list are configured in /etc/kbdguard/config.toml
